grammarFocus: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do / does 问句。
title: Study Goals and Habits: A Conversation with Mia
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力练习材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选题和填空题。填空题的答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定的字数。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. Do you have a minute? I want to ask you about study habits.
Ben: Sure, Mia. What do you want to know?
Mia: Well, I always make a study plan on Sunday evening. Do you make a plan?
Ben: No, I don't. I usually study when I feel like it. But I often forget things.
Mia: I see. I usually follow my plan, but sometimes I only do a little when I'm tired.
Ben: That's still good. How often do you review your notes?
Mia: I review my notes every day. I usually review for twenty minutes after class.
Ben: Wow, every day? I only review before exams. How long do you study each day?
Mia: I study for about two hours every evening. I take a short break every thirty minutes.
Ben: That's a lot. Do you study on weekends?
Mia: Yes, I do. I study for three hours on Saturday morning. On Sunday, I don't study. I relax.
Ben: That sounds nice. I sometimes study on Sunday, but I usually watch TV.
Mia: Do you study with friends?
Ben: No, I don't. I study alone. But I sometimes ask my sister for help.
Mia: That's good. I have a study group. We meet every Friday at the library.
Ben: How many people are in your group?
Mia: There are four of us. We help each other with difficult questions.
Ben: That's a good idea. Maybe I should join a group.
Mia: You can join ours! We are meeting this Friday at 5 p.m.
Ben: Thanks! I will think about it.

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does 问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯，常与频率副词（always, usually, often, sometimes, never）连用。现在进行时表示正在进行的动作，结构为be + 动词-ing。do/does 用于一般现在时的疑问句和否定句。
grammar.example: I always make a study plan on Sunday evening. (一般现在时+频率副词) / We are meeting this Friday at 5 p.m. (现在进行时表示将来安排) / Do you make a plan? (do 问句)

options: She always study in the evening.
She always studies in the evening.
She always studying in the evening.
answers: She always studies in the evening.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语是第三人称单数时，动词要加-s。因此正确句子是'She always studies in the evening.'
questions.evidence: She always studies in the evening.

questions.explanation: 一般现在时的疑问句，主语是第三人称单数时，用does，动词用原形。因此正确问句是'Does he study every day?'
现在进行时表示正在进行的动作，结构为be + 动词-ing。主语they是复数，be动词用are。因此正确句子是'They are playing football now.'

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a frequency adverb.
options: I usually go to the library on Saturday.
I go usually to the library on Saturday.
I am usually go to the library on Saturday.
answers: I usually go to the library on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 频率副词usually通常放在实义动词之前。因此正确句子是'I usually go to the library on Saturday.'
questions.evidence: I usually go to the library on Saturday.
